description: des_y3 apriori (prior-sampled) timing sweeps, 2026-08-26/27, shared Perlmutter GPU login node. Each run draws from the full mock_mcmc_widePlanck_values_mis.ini prior via CosmoSIS's apriori sampler with timing=T. 'n_failed_stderr' is a lower bound on true failures -- some successful completions can be mis-attributed to a failure due to stdout/stderr buffering interleaving in the log (see docs/pipelines/des_y3/README.md 'Prior-volume robustness').

fiducial_point_precision.note: Single-point comparisons at the shared widePlanck fiducial cosmology/HOD (verified identical cosmological_parameters and cluster_mor values across all sources).

one_halo_shear_reduced_6pt.note: cpp-0d and python-0d gave numerically identical values here (shear1h_gl.py is a direct Python re-expression of the production Shear1hMisSel/SelGLCore algorithm).

projection_shear_180pt.note: NOT re-derived this session (DSigmaPrj3dGpu's adaptive theta/z/lnM volume bounds were not confidently reconstructed in the time available -- risk of a silently-misconfigured integration domain). Using the pre-existing, pre-session documented number instead.
